description: A deliberately diverse paper corpus for stress-testing EvalVitals diagnosis and repair recommendations.

papers.title: TruthfulQA: Measuring How Models Mimic Human Falsehoods
papers.expected_stress_test: Separate a model-behaviour diagnosis from a benchmark or scoring artefact. A repair must be checked for truthfulness and helpfulness trade-offs.

papers.title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
papers.diagnosis_axis: multi-metric model health and evaluation coverage
papers.expected_stress_test: Do not collapse robustness, fairness, efficiency, calibration, and task accuracy into one health score or one proposed fix.

papers.title: SelfCheckGPT: Zero-Resource Black-Box Hallucination Detection for Generative Large Language Models
papers.expected_stress_test: Make uncertainty and sampling assumptions explicit; do not claim that disagreement alone identifies the causal source of a hallucination.

papers.title: HaluEval: A Large-Scale Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.expected_stress_test: Check whether a proposed repair transfers across hallucination types and whether generated benchmark cases create a shortcut.

papers.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
papers.diagnosis_axis: agent trajectory, environment, and tool-use failure
papers.expected_stress_test: Distinguish planning, tool-use, observation, and environment failures before recommending a prompt or scaffold repair.
